entities.summary: Deir el-Shelwit is an Egyptian temple built during the Greco-Roman period. Dedicated to Isis, a major goddess in the Egyptian religion, the temple stands on the west bank of the Nile at the city of Luxor, roughly 1 km (0.62 mi) from Malkata and about 4 km (2.5 mi) south of Medinet Habu.
